decisions.statement: The gap a cost is read from is the safety level less the difficulty level.
A stretch a full level inside the safety level costs nothing.
A stretch at the safety level costs one hour for each hour that stretch ran.
Each level the gap falls beneath the match roughly doubles the cost.
A gap is read at the nearest half step.
A half step is the finest step a level moves in.
A stretch stating no safety level or no difficulty level costs nothing.

definition: what an hour of a stretch costs, read off safety against difficulty
